entities.summary: Rollen Franklin Hans Jr. was an American professional basketball shooting guard who played two season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Baltimore Bullets. He attended Long Island University. He died in Seattle, Washington on August 30, 2021, at the age of 90.
